title: Scaling Up Visual and Vision-Language Representation Learning With Noisy Text Supervision
layout_note: Two bands split by a full-width horizontal rule. Top band: a small pre-training diagram on the left (cloud 'Noisy Image-Text Data' feeding a blue Text Encoder and a pink Image Encoder that meet in a 'Contrastive Learning' box above) and, after a vertical rule, the zero-shot visual tasks (an ImageNet prediction grid and a reproduced VTAB diagram). Bottom band: three retrieval examples (A) text->image, (B) image->text, (C) image+text->image, split by dotted rules.
grouping: Panels are separated only by thin rules (solid horizontal and vertical, dotted between the retrieval examples); no frames or tinted backgrounds. Bold section titles ('Pre-training', '(Zero-shot) Visual Tasks', 'Fine-grained Image-Text Retrieval') head each region, and (A)-(C) labels sit under the bottom examples.
shapes_depth: Flat: the two encoders are trapezoids (blue text, pink image) narrowing upward, the data source is a grey cloud outline, the objective a plain white rectangle; thin black arrows. The downstream panels are real photographs and two borrowed figures (ImageNet grid, VTAB schematic with a 3-D surface).
proposed_highlight: The method itself is the small top-left panel; it is not coloured differently from anything else, and its prominence comes from the curved arrows that leave the two encoders and fan out to every downstream panel.
lesson: A dual-encoder method can be drawn as a tiny two-trapezoid diagram whose curved arrows reach into every application panel, so the whole figure reads as 'one model, many uses'.
notes: Venue from the first page (Proceedings of the 38th ICML, PMLR 139, 2021). The ImageNet and VTAB panels are reproduced from other papers (credited in the figure).

arrangement.units: top band = pre-training panel (left) and zero-shot visual tasks (right) split by a vertical rule; bottom band = three retrieval examples split by dotted rules; bands split by a horizontal rule; no frames
arrangement.inputs_as: a cloud labelled 'Noisy Image-Text Data' under the encoders; downstream inputs as real photos and quoted text queries
arrangement.losses_at: one 'Contrastive Learning' box above the two encoders, where their arrows meet
arrangement.shared: the two encoders are drawn once, in the pre-training panel; arrows from them point into each downstream panel

taxonomy.task: image-text pretraining for zero-shot classification and retrieval

insights.structure: A small pre-training diagram sits in the top-left corner and the rest of the canvas is a grid of downstream-task panels, split by thin solid and dotted rules rather than frames.
insights.data: Training data is a single cloud shape labelled 'Noisy Image-Text Data', while downstream uses are shown with real photos and quoted alt-text queries in the retrieval examples.
insights.emphasis: Curved arrows leave the Text and Image Encoders and sweep to the visual-task and retrieval panels, making the two encoders the visual hub of the page.
insights.flow: Inside the method panel the flow runs bottom-to-top (cloud, encoders, contrastive box); outside it, curved arrows carry the eye right and down to the application panels.
insights.avoid: The contrastive objective is only a plain text box with no hint of the image-text similarity it computes, and the borrowed ImageNet/VTAB figures add visual noise unrelated to the method.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
